coverage.summary: Bounded workspace-recorded inventory as of 2026-10-26: 37 unique mainnet chain/address identities across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon; all 37 are executors, including legacy strategy contracts. 23 are receipt-backed (15 newer, 6 older, 2 Euler fleet results); 14 are recorded-only. No own helper or testnet deployment was established. This is not new chain enumeration or a guarantee of complete deployment history.
exclusions: Local/fork deployments, including chain 31337; compiled-only contracts; CREATE2 predictions without qualifying live deployment evidence; and audited third-party protocol contracts are not counted.

Staged BuilderPay's 7,913-byte runtime completed a historical local rehearsal but is not a live deployment. The staged branch uses strict conservative net > 0, not the superseded 100-USDC floor. In-progress #1/#M1 upgrades owned by another worker are excluded.

Base-paper-usdplus r12/r13 deployment JSONs are downloaded official Overnight protocol artifacts, not our helper deployments (tools/run-base-paper-usdplus-exit-r13.js:54-61,97-105 and tools/run-base-paper-usdplus-exit-r12.js:19-21).
Polygon-robin authority deployment/broadcast artifacts originate from the imported third-party Robin repository; they are not workspace-owned deployments.
Observation-attempt1-deploy-poll is diagnostic polling evidence, not a successful deployment receipt.
No own Base Sepolia harness deployment was established; a harness source file is not deployment evidence.
Consolidated reports/raw/fast/current-deployments.json and historical runtime observations repeat identities; they do not add extra rows or independently upgrade manifests to receipt-backed evidence.
gaps: Arbitrum configured-only 0x08be4f3e07ef8a2c2f13cefdafcf9a82b5efe675 at dashboard/targets.py:45 lacks a qualifying deployment record and is not counted. The actual original runner loads the 0x2175290a1132fb5e49f6e96cb1610e2cdd7b81c4 receipt.

Ethereum configured-only 0x6125ba227a66a1efbb780d445ea6b79f8b285e1f at dashboard/ops.py:2847 lacks a qualifying deployment record and is not counted; it is not the receipt-backed Uniswap V4 executor 0x61251a22540e7148cc8ba58cfb0916a898865e1f.
Euler plan F1/F2 primary receipts are not recovered. Retained fleet-status batch-local F1/F2 are distinct plan F3/F4; aliases must never merge these addresses.
E35/E36 exact source/runtime bindings are missing; source_paths intentionally remain empty. E9's primary manifest also has null transaction and gas fields.
Legacy Aave source/runner ABI mismatch, provisional Morpho Router02 binding, Fluid candidate-skeleton completion gap and Liquity BOLD runtime mismatch remain visible holds.
Current ownership, bytecode, balances, liquidity, eligibility, profit and authorization were not queried. Historical immutables-masked matches are not full runtime identity or owner proof.

tools/audit-job-catalog.json maps the combined top-whale-trigger-executor job to the read-only watch-top-whale-triggers.js alias. Actual execute-top-whale-trigger.js associations therefore have null job_id and unmapped executor-only liveness. Near/Base/Arbitrum/Euler scripts are also unregistered; legacy handlers are not active-runner bindings.
No qualifying own helper/testnet deployment found in the bounded supplied records; this does not prove no such deployments exist elsewhere or in unrecovered history.

notices: Read-only curated catalog, not a chain scan or an execution control. Deployment evidence and runner process observations are separate from readiness and authorization.
Dedupe identity is chain ID plus lowercase address. The Ethereum LB / Base Universal Euler address collision and Optimism / Arbitrum E10 address collision intentionally remain separate rows.

All source paths identify candidate sources or recorded associations, not a guarantee that current compilation equals deployed bytecode. Runtime hashes and compiler metadata are dated historical observations; no fresh ownership or bytecode claim is made.

Receipt-backed means a retained successful deployment result, not current verification. Recorded-only manifests may include transaction, time or gas values without a retained successful receipt; unknown values stay null.
Explicit owner records are retained only for Unified V4/V3, dedicated V4 and the five Universal deployments. Actor/deployer fields and masked immutable comparisons are not substituted for owners.
Runner associations describe capabilities, not current RUNNING status. Only the dedicated Aave V4 script maps to a dedicated current Jobs ID; watcher aliases cannot prove executor liveness.

No current capacity or profitability is established. Promotion requires conservative net > 0 after every debt/funding obligation, acquisition/unwind cost, fee, slippage, gas, competition and uncertainty haircut. Historical fee models are not deployed pricing.

The consumed rank1 event remains consumed; it does not permanently disable all modes of its reusable contract. Staged BuilderPay and separate in-progress upgrades confer no live deployment or execution authority.
